feed.title: Disclosure: DoS vulnerabilities fixed in Eclair v0.14.1

entry.title: Disclosure: DoS vulnerabilities fixed in Eclair v0.14.1
entry.summary: The mobile wallet that operates with an Eclair node as a Lightning Service Provider (LSP), such as the Phoenix wallet, remains unaffected by the recent vulnerabilities identified in certain nodes. This is due to the proactive measures taken by ACINQ, the developers behind Eclair. They had already addressed and patched these potential security issues several months prior, ensuring continued security and reliability of their service. This preemptive approach highlights the importance of regular updates and maintenance in safeguarding digital transactions against emerging threats.
